title: Former Upstate NY mayor convicted of rape, faces up to 25 years
summary: A former mayor of Laurens, NY (Frank W. Kovacs II, age 62) was convicted of first-degree rape following a four-day jury trial on October 8, 2026. He faces up to 25 years in prison. This is a criminal justice matter handled by Otsego County authorities outside Syracuse's jurisdiction.

political_signal.description: Criminal conviction of elected official may prompt local government to review ethics policies, training, or oversight mechanisms; potential reputational concern for upstate NY municipal leadership.
